home.title: BrewLingo
home.subtitle: Learn coffee. Actually learn it.

hero.title: BrewLingo
hero.sub: BrewLingo turns the complex craft of specialty coffee into bite-sized, gamified lessons  guided by floating 3D islands, not dry textbooks.

features.label: What you get
features.title: Everything to level up your brew

f1.title: 3D Chapter Map
f1.body: Navigate your learning journey through interactive floating islands  each one a new chapter waiting to be unlocked.

f2.title: Micro-learning
f2.body: No walls of text. Complex extraction theory is sliced into short, punchy lessons you can finish between brews.

f3.title: Smart Onboarding
f3.body: Tell us your gear and experience level. BrewLingo generates a personalised roadmap that skips what you already know.

f4.title: Streaks & XP
f4.body: Daily streaks, XP rewards and instant quiz feedback keep you motivated to come back  one chapter at a time.

f5.title: Multilingual
f5.body: Available in Dutch, English and French. The content adapts to you, not the other way around.

f6.title: iOS & Android
f6.body: Built with React Native + Expo so every phone feels native combined a strong NestJs backend

how.label: The journey
how.title: From zero to barista in five steps

s1.title: Download & open
s1.body: Splash screen. First impression. You're already curious.

s2.title: Smart intake
s2.body: Select your hardware and level. Your personalised roadmap is generated on the spot.

s3.title: Explore the islands
s3.body: Swipe through 3D chapters on the dashboard. Each island is a world of coffee knowledge.

s4.title: Learn & quiz
s4.body: Bite-sized theory pages, then a quiz. Instant feedback. XP earned.

s5.title: Apply in the kitchen
s5.body: Close the app. Make coffee. Notice the difference.

home.quote: Specialty coffee is not a final product  it is a precise, unbroken chain of dedication.

tech.label: Under the hood
tech.title: Built for performance
tech.body: End-to-end TypeScript. A strongly-typed GraphQL API between NestJS and React Native, with automatic code generation so front-end and back-end stay in sync forever. Three.js renders the 3D islands natively on mobile via React Three Fiber  smooth, battery-friendly, and genuinely impressive on older devices.

ctaBlock.title: Ready to brew better?
ctaBlock.sub: Start your personalised coffee education today. No dry textbooks. No passive videos. Just you, your brew, and BrewLingo.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At BrewLingo, we take your privacy seriously. This privacy policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it.
privacyPolicy.section1Content: When you create an account, we collect your email address and username. We also track your app progress (such as completed lessons and your daily streak) to provide you with the best learning experience.
privacyPolicy.section2Content: We strictly use your data to operate the app, save your progress, and improve the application using anonymous analytics. We never sell your personal data to third parties.
privacyPolicy.section3Content: Your data is securely stored and protected against unauthorized access. We do not retain your data longer than necessary for the purposes for which it was collected.
privacyPolicy.section4Content: You have the right to access, correct, or completely delete your data at any time. You can do this directly through the account settings in the app or by contacting us.

termsOfCondition.section3Content: While we strive for a seamless app experience, we cannot guarantee that the service will always be online or error-free. We reserve the right to modify, update, or (temporarily) suspend the app's features at any time.
termsOfCondition.section4Content: The information provided in this app is strictly for educational purposes.
